configuration.robust_scale: 1.4826 * median absolute deviation across all model heads, separately per category and fold
configuration.robust_scale_zero: above median -> +infinity; equal median -> zero; below median -> -infinity
configuration.null_exclusion: same pair or identical ordered endpoint pair
configuration.multiplicity_family: all category-head hypotheses screened in each configuration; recompute BH for every configuration and source subset; inadequate coverage has p=1
configuration.AP_statistic: mean numerical-floor-corrected absolute antisymmetric effect minus matched-control mean
configuration.CF_statistic: mean label-aligned signed antisymmetric effect minus matched-control mean
configuration.direction_filter: source-cluster bootstrap mean agrees with observed source-balanced contrast direction

stability_criteria.empty_groups: not evidence of stable functional identification
stability_criteria.application: all one-factor neighbours of default; joint extremes descriptive; no automatic threshold replacement

configuration.independent_confirmation: No replacement default is adopted without independent training-source confirmation; present scan is exploratory.
